eventDetail.scope: The 2nd International Conference on Emerging Trends in Computing and Engineering Applications (ETCEA27) encompasses a broad yet technically rigorous scope focusing on the full spectrum of modern computing and interdisciplinary innovation. The technical scope bridges foundational research with practical advancements across four primary domains: Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, featuring core methodologies like Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Computer Vision; Cyber Security & Networking, emphasizing digital forensics, blockchain, and wireless sensor networks; Software Engineering & Internet of Things, focusing on edge/fog computing and system integration ; and Interdisciplinary AI Applications, highlighting high-impact deployments such as Green AI for sustainability, Smart Cities, and bioinformatics.
